title.why: Copyright page: 'Governing AI for Humanity: Final Report'.

issuing_body.why: Annex B and 'About' page: convened by the UN Secretary-General, formed October 2023.

date_published.why: Cover shows 'September 2024' with no day, so YYYY-MM is right.

status.why: The report is the final of the body's two reports (Annex B), and the Scientific Panel FAQ says the body concluded its work in 2024.

legal_force.why: Report of an advisory body, 'majority consensus'; recommendations only.

official_identifier.why: None: the report has no document symbol on the stored copy.

summary_claims.claim: seven recommendations: scientific panel, policy dialogue, AI standards exchange, capacity development network, global fund for AI, global AI data framework, AI office
summary_claims.locator: contents list, page 3 to 4; sections pages 40 to 70

summary_claims.claim: does not currently recommend an international AI agency
summary_claims.locator: page 73: 'we do not currently recommend establishing such an agency.'

note: All values are supported by the stored report and by the Scientific Panel FAQ on un.org. The note that recommendations 1 and 2 were taken up in the Global Digital Compact and established by resolution 79/325 is backed by the FAQ page. No newer edition found.
